title: CR-0005: close post-CR-0004 critical/high security findings (admin takeover, SSRF, weak approval secret)
body:
The post-CR-0004 re-assessment confirmed the backup/restore surface added by CR-0004 introduced a default-open whole-datastore takeover (`/admin/restore`) and anonymous secret export (`/admin/backup`), and that pre-existing critical findings remained open: SSRF + cloud-key exfiltration via the model connectivity test, a well-known default approval HMAC secret, and a `cryptography` floor incorrectly marked "clean". This change remediates all of them under the repo's CR → ADR → plan → STATUS chain.

## Governance (CR-0005)
- **CR-0005** + **ADR-020** (backup/restore default-deny), **ADR-021** (egress policy), **ADR-022** (approval-secret strength).
- ADR-019 carries a supersession note; `security_requirements.md` (Areas 2/3/6/9), `dependency-audit.md`, README, `plans/phase-4.md`, `STATUS.md` updated to match.

## Admin backup/restore — default-deny + restore safety (ADR-020)
- `GET /admin/backup` and `POST /admin/restore` now require a configured admin key **or** an unlocked vault; otherwise `403`. All other admin routes keep the ADR-019 model.
- Restore caps per-member decompressed size, validates the candidate DB with `PRAGMA integrity_check` in a staging file, snapshots the prior `kaval.db`/`kaval.yaml`, then atomically swaps via `os.replace`. Still writes only the two known member names.

## Outbound egress / SSRF guard (ADR-021)
- New `src/kaval/api/egress.py` resolves the model-test target and rejects loopback/link-local/private/unique-local/unspecified/reserved/cloud-metadata destinations (fail-closed on DNS error). Private/loopback are permitted only via `KAVAL_ALLOW_PRIVATE_MODEL_EGRESS=true`; metadata stays blocked regardless.
- Local-model tests preserve their inherently-private endpoint (e.g. Ollama on localhost) but never reach the metadata address.
- Stored (vault-backed) keys are no longer replayed when the staged `base_url` differs from the active one — the operator must supply the key inline for a changed endpoint.

## Approval-secret strength (ADR-022)
- `get_approval_hmac_secret` rejects the known-bad default and secrets shorter than 32 bytes; `docker-compose.yml` no longer ships a default (`${VAR:?...}` required syntax); `.env.example` documents generation.

## Dependency floor
- `cryptography` raised to `>=46.0.7,<47` (CVE-2026-26007, PYSEC-2026-35/36); dependency-audit artifact corrected.

```python
# admin authorizer: default-deny unless key OR unlocked vault
if expected_api_key is None:
    if vault_unlocked:
        return
    raise HTTPException(403, "admin backup/restore requires an unlocked credential "
                             "vault or a configured KAVAL_ADMIN_API_KEY")
```

## Notes for reviewers
- CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs `tests/unit|contract|integration` only — the new `tests/security` coverage does not gate PRs. Left unchanged as out of scope; flag if you want it enforced.
